title: The Touch-Type Anthem
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
The Touch-Type Anthem
(Spoken Intro)
(A steady, rhythmic clicking of mechanical keyboard switches fades in, locking into a mid-tempo hip-hop beat. A heavy bassline drops.)
Yeah, listen up.
It’s time to upgrade your interface.
No more hunt and peck. No more two-finger typing.
We’re building muscle memory tonight.
Align your spine. Breathe in.
Let’s ride the home row.

Verse 1
First things first, let’s talk about the posture,
Sitting like a shrimp is a recipe for torture.
Feet flat on the floor, keep your back up straight,
Screen at eye level, man, it’s never too late.
Drop your shoulders down, let the tension release,
We’re about to make the keyboard an absolute masterpiece.
Elbows at a ninety-degree, hovering light,
We’re setting up the foundation to get it right.

Verse 2
Now bring those hands up, but don’t let the wrists drop,
If they’re resting on the desk, then you’re gonna have to stop.
Keep 'em floating like a butterfly, steady and keen,
Eyes off the plastic, keep your eyes on the screen.
It’s a blindfold game, it’s a tactile dance,
If you’re looking at your fingers, you don’t stand a chance.
It’s about the proprioception, knowing where you are,
Ready to accelerate and shoot for the stars.

Pre-Chorus
Feel the little bumps, find 'em in the dark,
That’s the F and the J, that’s the starting mark.
Anchor down your spirit, let the rhythm flow,
Everybody get ready for the grand show!

Chorus
Take it to the home row, A-S-D-F!
Right hand J-K-L and the semicolon, yes!
This is where we live, this is where we breathe,
Every single keystroke is a trick up our sleeve!
Accuracy first, let the speed come next,
We’re dominating data, we are mastering the text!
From the left to the right, keep the center line tight,
Touch typing on the board all through the night!

Verse 3
Let’s break down the left, give the fingers their roles,
Pinky on the A, taking absolute control.
Ring finger on the S, keeping everything aligned,
Middle on the D, yeah, it’s brilliantly designed.
Index on the F, feeling for the little ridge,
It’s the guardian of the keys, it’s the builder of the bridge.
And that index finger stretches, hits the G and the R,
Hits the T and the V, yeah, it travels pretty far.

Verse 4
Slide over to the right, let’s balance out the scale,
Index on the J, we are never gonna fail.
It catches H and the U, the Y and the M,
It’s a multitasking maestro, an absolute gem.
Middle finger on the K, hitting I and the comma,
No stress on the tendons, no typing drama.
Ring finger on the L, reaches up to the O,
Pinky on the semicolon, ready for the show!

Verse 5
Now what about the thumbs? Are they taking a break?
No, they’re hovering the spacebar, keeping you awake.
You only need one, usually the dominant hand,
To strike down the space, the conductor of the band.
It gives the words room, it gives the text air,
Without the little spaces, it’s a claustrophobe's nightmare.
Tap it with the side, keep it gentle and quick,
It’s the heartbeat of the sentence, the metronome tick.

Pre-Chorus
Feel the little bumps, find 'em in the dark,
That’s the F and the J, that’s the starting mark.
Anchor down your spirit, let the rhythm flow,
Everybody get ready for the grand show!

Chorus
Take it to the home row, A-S-D-F!
Right hand J-K-L and the semicolon, yes!
This is where we live, this is where we breathe,
Every single keystroke is a trick up our sleeve!
Accuracy first, let the speed come next,
We’re dominating data, we are mastering the text!
From the left to the right, keep the center line tight,
Touch typing on the board all through the night!

Verse 6
Let’s elevate the game, take it to the top row,
QWERTY on the left, let the fingertips flow.
Pinky stretches up for the Q, ring for the W,
Middle grabs the E, yeah there’s nothing that can trouble you.
Right hand jumps up, pinky on the P,
Ring finger on the O, middle on the I, see?
Always coming back, never drifting away,
The home row is the anchor where the fingers must stay.

Verse 7
Time to dive deep, taking it to the bottom,
Z, X, C, V, B—make sure that you’ve got 'em.
Left hand curling under, pinky hits the Z,
Ring hits the X, it’s as easy as can be.
Middle hits the C, and the index grabs the V and B,
We’re weaving through the letters like a ship upon the sea.
Right hand curling down, index hits the N and M,
Ring and middle hit the periods, we’re finishing the stem!

Verse 8
Now we need some punctuation, we need to shout loud,
Holding down the Shift key, standing up proud.
Use the opposite pinky of the letter that you type,
If you’re reaching with the left, let the right pinky swipe.
Capitalize the words, hit the exclamation mark,
Lighting up the document, shining in the dark.
Don't rely on Caps Lock unless you're really mad,
Just coordinate the pinkies, it's really not that bad.

Bridge 1
Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
If you rush the keystrokes, the speed will never last.
Don't worry 'bout the WPM at the start,
Typing isn't just a science, man, it is an art.
